description: Y.A.R. Portfolio Review + Spark Sessions: Charm Making Youth (Ages 13 – 17) | Free, Drop-In Program December 22 (PA DAY) | 12:00 – 3:00 pm Underground Gallery (Level B1) | 50 Victoria Street, Aurora The Gallery Team at the Aurora Cultural Centre is offering free Portfolio Reviews for youths interested in pursuing arts post-secondary. Bring your art portfolio and questions for feedback and advice. Spark Session will be occurring simultaneously, launch into your winter holiday by fueling your creative self or an opportunity for a last-minute handmade gift. Spark Sessions are free, recurring, student-led arts and craft workshops for youth from ages 13 to 17. Each Spark Session is themed, with materials and snacks provided at no cost (while quantities last). This session’s theme: Charm Making About Youth Artists on the Rise! (YAR): Spark Sessions run as part of Youth Artists on the Rise! (YAR), a community for arts-impassioned youth ages 13-17 to develop their skills in the arts, make connections, and build a community for collaboration and growth. Participants have access to art studio space, exhibiting opportunities, and workshops. Register for YAR now!
